description.description: The MSTP instance description. Max limit = 256.

instance_number.description: The MSTP instance number. Valid values are 0-255.

instance_priority.description: The MSTP instance priority. Valid values are 0-15.

name.description: The name of the MSTP instance. Max limit = 128.

tags.description: A information field that can be added to identify the MSTP instance. Maximum 10 unique tags of length 128 each are allowed.
